args.summary: checkout-api failed health checks after the v2.3.1 production deploy (18% error rate, unhealthy in us-east, us-west, eu-west). Rolled back all production regions to v2.3.0, the most recent release that was healthy in production. Rollback completed and verified; health status re-checked post-rollout. Root cause of the v2.3.1 failure still under investigation.
args.title: checkout-api rollback from v2.3.1 to v2.3.0 due to failing health checks

trace.final:
All done. Summary:

1. **Diagnosed the issue**: checkout-api was running v2.3.1 across all regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west) and was unhealthy with an 18% error rate. Deployment history showed v2.3.1 was the only unhealthy production release; the most recent healthy one was **v2.3.0**.
2. **Rolled back** all production regions to v2.3.0. This required no change-manager approval since v2.3.0 was already a healthy production release. The rollout was executed and verified.
3. **Confirmed recovery**: checkout-api is now healthy again in all regions running v2.3.0, with the error rate down from 18% to 0.2%.
4. **Opened a SEV2 incident** (INC-0001, idempotency-keyed to prevent duplicates) documenting the failed v2.3.1 deploy, the rollback action, and the verified recovery. On-call has been paged.
